items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) FMRB executive order T-minus-2 days: seventh witness (DOE CESER Assistant Secretary) added; ABA + NAAG join requesting cohort; amicus coalition grows to fourteen organizations
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday entered the three-business-day window before the May 15 14:00 EDT classified threshold briefing with the witness slate at six (Locascio plus ODNI cyber plus NSA Cyber plus MSTIC plus CISA Director plus FCC PSHSB Bureau Chief), the House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee on Communications and Technology Chair sent a Tuesday-morning joint letter to OSTP requesting a parallel 30-day House technical review window, and the Brennan Center plus Stanford Center for Internet and Society filed a joint Tuesday amicus joining the twelve-organization coalition. Today enters the two-business-day window. Senate Cyber Subcommittee staff release a Wednesday-morning hearing-readiness memo confirming the witness slate firms to seven with the addition of the Department of Energy Cyber Security, Energy Security, and Emergency Response Assistant Secretary, joining the previously-confirmed cohort. The American Bar Association Cybersecurity Legal Task Force and the National Association of Attorneys General AI working group file a joint Wednesday amicus letter joining the now-fourteen-organization coalition, narrowing focus to the per-state attorney-general consultation pathway plus the AISI cyber-evaluation reciprocity 120-day placement window alignment. The House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee issues a Wednesday-afternoon follow-up press release confirming a coordinated request bundle with the Senate Cyber Subcommittee for the parallel 30-day House technical review window. OSTP holds the Wednesday-afternoon line that the executive order draft remains in interagency review with no signing window before May 22; the Senate Cyber Subcommittee confirms the May 15 briefing proceeds on schedule.

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter reaches twelve jurisdictions with Brazil; first African observer (South Africa) confirms cross-continental extension
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday the cohort lifted to eleven named candidates after Thailand's NCSA plus Ministry of Digital Economy and Society jointly published a Tuesday entry note as formal observers with a 180-day consultation window targeting Q1 2027 mirror signature, and Chile's National Cybersecurity Coordination Office plus the Mexican Federal Institute of Telecommunications confirmed exploratory observer status — the first cross-hemispheric extension. Today Brazil's Cybersecurity Authority (ANCiber) publishes a Wednesday entry note converting prior open-ended observer interest into a formal exploratory-observer commitment with a 240-day national-consultation window targeting Q2 2027 mirror signature, lifting the cohort to twelve named candidates plus the originating UK and EU. South Africa's Cybersecurity Hub plus the Department of Communications and Digital Technologies separately announce a parallel exploratory-observer track with a 270-day consultation window — the first African entry into the cohort and the first cross-continental extension since the Latin American Tuesday landing. Mistral plus Anthropic plus OpenAI plus Google DeepMind reaffirm cohort participation; the operational threshold remains Mythos-class plus GPT-5.5-class capability. The OECD GENAI working-group secretariat publishes a Wednesday-afternoon procedural note describing the cohort as on track toward the first thirteen-jurisdiction formal mirror count by Q3 2026. The US recognition gap is now a full Wednesday wider than the Tuesday baseline.

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Cerebras CBRS Wednesday consolidation near $196; Wells Fargo Securities initiates Buy at $208; Morgan Stanley adds $235 upside scenario
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday's Tuesday session printed a clean intraday extension after Monday's gap-up with opening at $193.20, high-of-day at $197.10 at 13:45 EDT, settling into a $194-$196 range, trailing-five-session turnover crossing $4.8B, institutional-buyside cumulative net position at 31 percent of float, and 4.1x call-skew at 14:00 EDT (61,400 calls vs 14,950 puts — widest since IPO debut). Today's session prints a textbook second-trading-week consolidation: opening at $195.40 (+0.7 percent from Tuesday's $194.10 close), intraday range tight at $193.80-$197.60, close at $195.80, trailing-five-session turnover crossing $5.6B, institutional-buyside cumulative net position at an estimated 33 percent of float. Bernstein issues a Wednesday-morning sector note describing the post-IPO price action as having shifted from a single-event re-rating into a second-trading-week structural extension, holding the $172 Market-Perform floor but acknowledging the consolidation pattern materially reduces the single-counterparty concentration discount; Morgan Stanley reiterates the Tuesday best-ideas-list at the $192 target and adds an explicit upside-tilt scenario at $235 conditional on Saudi Aramco Digital MoU closure; Wells Fargo Securities initiates Buy at $208. Options trade at a 3.6x call-skew at 14:00 EDT (58,300 calls vs 16,200 puts) — the second-widest call-skew since the IPO debut session.

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) SEC Corp Fin ships second sample comment letter plus topical comment Wednesday; SambaNova confidential cover-letter draft cites Tenstorrent as precedent; Groq closure timeline pulls forward
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday Tenstorrent received its SEC Corp Fin Tuesday confidential-submission acknowledgement under the JOBS Act EGC framework, formally opening the 30-60 day review window with the May 8 Corp Fin sample comment letter plus the Cerebras CBRS single-counterparty risk-factor exhibit pattern flagged in working notes as the operative precedent set; SambaNova added Barclays Capital as the fifth joint lead bookrunner with the late-June confidential-submission target unchanged; Groq's process was 30-60 days behind. Today the SEC Division of Corporation Finance posts a Wednesday-morning EDGAR release that pairs a second sample comment letter on AI-services-revenue measurement basis (specifically addressing usage-tiered hyperscaler contract recognition timing plus committed-purchase-order treatment ambiguity) with a topical comment template on hyperscaler-anchor warrant-equity counterparty disclosure shape — a fresh second precedent-set element absent in Tuesday's review notes. SambaNova Systems publishes a Wednesday confidential-submission cover-letter draft for late-June filing with the bookrunner roster locked at five; CFO commentary in the cover-letter draft references the Tenstorrent confidential acknowledgement as the operative precedent. Groq receives a Wednesday Reuters Asia wire flag that the Saudi PIF contingent secondary closure timeline pulls forward from 30-60 days into the 21-45 day window, with the Saudi Aramco Digital MoU close described as on track for late-Q2 2026.

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Mag-7 Wednesday positioning: Jefferies joins preview cohort; Bernstein lifts Alphabet AI-Services-footnote probability to 78 percent; AWS expectations pulled forward another quarter
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday Bernstein, Wells Fargo Securities, Evercore ISI, and Citi Research each published Tuesday-morning preview updates lifting the Alphabet Q2 AI Services footnote probability to 72 percent (from 65 percent Monday) citing the post-IPO Cerebras CBRS valuation as the operative AI-accelerator-revenue multiple comparable; VentureBeat aggregated that Wells Fargo plus Evercore ISI jointly expected Meta to follow Alphabet within one quarter, while AWS was now expected to ship a fiscal-Q3 2026 AI Services breakout one quarter ahead of fiscal Q4. Today Bernstein, Wells Fargo Securities, Evercore ISI, Citi Research, and now Jefferies each publish Wednesday-morning preview updates; Bernstein lifts the probability to 78 percent (from 72 percent Tuesday) citing both the Wednesday Cerebras CBRS consolidation print and the Wednesday Corp Fin second sample comment letter as material structural additions to the operative pricing-event set. VentureBeat aggregates that Wells Fargo plus Evercore ISI plus Jefferies now jointly expect Meta to ship the AI Services breakout in the fiscal Q3 2026 print one quarter ahead of Alphabet's previously-anticipated Q4 cadence, while AWS is now expected to ship in fiscal Q3 2026 alongside Meta (one quarter ahead of Tuesday's modeled cadence). The May 21 Alphabet analyst day remains the operative pricing event at T-minus-eight calendar days.

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Ni8mare day-thirteen: post-Tuesday taper to 3.2x baseline; Manjusaka + Empire added to C2 attribution; T-minus-8 business days to May 21 deadline
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday day-twelve scan dropped exposed pre-1.121.0 n8n instances to approximately 4,210 (-14.4 percent from Monday) with US at 1,395 and India at 720; Censys reported exploitation attempts moderate to 4.7x baseline at 09:00 UTC; Microsoft Defender plus CrowdStrike Falcon plus SentinelOne Singularity published a joint Tuesday telemetry note adding Brute Ratel plus Havoc to the C2 attribution alongside Cobalt Strike plus Sliver plus Mythic. Censys reports exploitation attempts moderate further to approximately 3.2x baseline at 09:00 UTC. The three defensive vendors publish a Wednesday joint follow-on telemetry note adding Manjusaka plus Empire to the C2-framework attribution alongside Tuesday's five frameworks, providing the first cross-vendor seven-framework C2 attribution baseline. CISA refreshes the KEV catalog entry with a Wednesday-edition reminder that the May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline now sits at T-minus-8 business days; the CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft incorporating the Trail of Bits eight-CVE taxonomy reaches the formal interagency-review window per Wednesday wire reporting.

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) MCP-server attack-surface gap holds at 50x; Cisco-Astrix tenancy crosses 1,720; CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI crosses 80 percent cross-vendor visibility threshold
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday Sysdig reported the unprotected-estate median time-to-first-credential-extraction collapsed from 8 to 5 minutes Tuesday while Defender-protected held at 4.2 hours — the gap stretching to 50x (vs 30x Monday); Wiz placed Defender-for-Cloud quarantine at 36 percent of net-new MCP servers; Cisco-Astrix tenancy crossed 1,470 with Akamai SkyAtlas at 720; CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI shipped its Tuesday public preview lifting cross-vendor visibility to 74 percent. Today Sysdig reports the median holds at 5 minutes (the second consecutive day at that floor) while Defender-protected extends to 4.4 hours — the unprotected-versus-protected gap holds the 50x baseline with the protected-tenant detection latency improving. Wiz Research reports Defender-for-Cloud quarantine reaches 39 percent on net-new MCP servers (vs 36 percent Tuesday), the third consecutive day of quarantine-rate expansion; Cisco-Astrix tenancy crosses 1,720 (vs 1,470 Tuesday, +17 percent) with Akamai SkyAtlas reaching 920 tenants in parallel. CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI extends the Tuesday public preview rolling out a Wednesday Vertex AI Agent Governance Center managed-interop visibility integration, lifting cross-vendor agentic-AI control-plane visibility to 81 percent of new MCP-server provisioning events — the first time cross-vendor coverage crosses the 80 percent threshold.

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) AutoGen CVE-2026-44918 lands as ninth agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader CVE, extending the taxonomy to the workflow-state path tier
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892 (CVSS 8.4) dropped Tuesday-morning Pacific as the eighth CVE in the Trail of Bits taxonomy, extending the wave from the agent-checkpoint-loader path to the inference-routing tier with an authenticated server-side request forgery in the tool-result-cache validator; the DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft Tuesday joint follow-up preprint (arxiv 2605.06712) extended the Monday Signed-Checkpoint paper with a runtime-verifier integration pattern. Today a fresh agentic-AI tooling-stack CVE drops at the workflow-state path tier: AutoGen CVE-2026-44918 (CVSS 8.6) is a path-traversal vulnerability in the workflow-state checkpoint loader that lets an attacker overwrite arbitrary host paths during checkpoint restore, mirroring the LangGraph CVE-2026-44712 deserialization pattern but with a different exploitation surface. The AutoGen maintainer team ships v0.6.4 same-day with the patch plus a paired backport advisory for the v0.5.x and v0.4.x branches the NHS England blocklist references. Trail of Bits publishes a Wednesday extended addendum updating its taxonomy from eight to nine CVEs (adding AutoGen workflow-state path traversal), reaffirming the signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist-validation common-mitigation pattern now extended with workflow-state path-canonicalization as the third tier. DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft co-publish a Wednesday joint follow-up addendum v2 (arxiv 2605.06712v2) extending the Tuesday preprint to the workflow-state tier.

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Claude Code 3.0 day-six crosses 23,000-skill mark; Mythos cohort grows to 56 after Indra, Saab Kockums, ST Engineering, Rafael sign — Mediterranean-Pacific defense extension
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday day-five lifted published skills to 21,640 (+9.3 percent — the second sub-15-percent daily gain), installs to 2.18M (14 percent acceleration), auto-quarantines to 42, with Norway's Kongsberg plus Finland's Nokia Defense plus Australia's CEA Technologies signing the Mythos rider lifting the gated cohort to 52, and Simon Willison documenting cross-tenant compositional safety checks completing in under 90 seconds. Today day-six lifts published skills to 23,210 (+7.3 percent — the third sub-15-percent daily gain and first sub-10-percent reading) with 2.32M installs across the sixth 24 hours (6 percent acceleration over day-five — the smallest day-over-day acceleration since launch). Auto-quarantined Mythos-class skills reach 48 (up from 42 Tuesday). Spain's Indra Sistemas Defense Operations, Sweden's Saab Kockums Submarine Systems, Singapore's ST Engineering Land Systems, and Israel's Rafael Advanced Defense Systems all sign the contractual ethics-and-misuse rider on the Wednesday business open, lifting the gated cohort to 56 enterprise customers and extending the rider's reach to the Mediterranean-plus-Indo-Pacific allied defense industrial base. Simon Willison's Wednesday note documents that the open-source verification harness now produces a deterministic per-tenant attestation-log audit trail across all 56 gated tenants with cross-tenant compositional safety checks completing in under 75 seconds — Stanford CIS batch-processing optimization contributed the improvement.

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Mistral Workflows day-thirteen lands Spain Agencia Estatal de Administracion Tributaria as fifth sovereign-cloud central-government reference; four-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix moves to public preview

The four-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix (Codex CLI + Claude Code 3.0 + Mistral Workflows + Azure AI Foundry + Vertex AI Agent Governance Center) moves from private preview to public preview Wednesday, with the matrix shipment cadence targeting the same mid-June framework-wide signed-checkpoint default-shipment window now extended to cover orchestrator-side reciprocity-attestation tenant-policy field interop.

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) OpenAI per-org agent registry GA extends to South Korea and Australia sovereign-cloud Wednesday; Codex CLI v3.1.1 ships workflow-state path-canonicalization mitigation
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday OpenAI announced the Tuesday general-availability launch of the ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry for Singapore-cloud-region tenants and Japan-cloud-region tenants on Microsoft Azure plus AWS Bedrock plus Google Cloud Vertex simultaneously, citing the May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI memorandum and the Sunday-shipped South Korea PIPC plus New Zealand GCSB cyber-eval reciprocity attestation fields, with Codex CLI v3.1.0 shipping signature-verified manifest-allowlist-validation; per-org agent registry tenancy under the GA cohort reached 87 enterprise customers by Tuesday business close. Today OpenAI announces a second-wave general-availability extension of the per-org agent registry to South-Korea-cloud-region tenants and Australia-cloud-region tenants on Microsoft Azure plus AWS Bedrock plus Google Cloud Vertex simultaneously, doubling the Indo-Pacific sovereign-cloud GA-tier coverage from two regions to four. Codex CLI v3.1.1 ships with a Wednesday point release upgrading the signature-verified manifest-allowlist-validation flow per the v2 reference implementation plus adding workflow-state path-canonicalization mitigation per the AutoGen CVE pattern. Per-org agent registry tenancy under the GA cohort reaches 168 enterprise customers by Wednesday business close (up from 87 Tuesday).

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Unsloth ships quad-Hopper forward-and-backward pass + first workflow-state mitigation Wednesday — first local-LLM fine-tuning stack to land the third-tier mitigation; Apple Mac Pro 2026 M5 Ultra reproduction
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday's Tuesday changelog added a fifth refinement track: a kernel-fused tensor-parallel router-attention backward pass on dual-Hopper workstation tiers reporting a further 14 percent training-step time reduction plus a 9 percent peak combined VRAM reduction on Llama 4 Behemoth router-only training, and the first production landing of the joint-preprint signed-checkpoint primitive making Unsloth the first local-LLM fine-tuning stack to ship at that tier. Today's Wednesday changelog adds a sixth refinement track plus extends the signed-checkpoint primitive to the workflow-state path tier: a kernel-fused tensor-parallel router-attention forward-and-backward pass on quad-Hopper workstation tiers reporting a further 11 percent training-step time reduction versus the Tuesday dual-Hopper-only mode plus a 7 percent peak combined VRAM reduction on Llama 4 Behemoth router-only training (compounding on Tuesday); a deterministic workflow-state path-canonicalization mitigation tied to the AutoGen CVE-2026-44918 Wednesday disclosure and the DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic Wednesday v2 joint preprint addendum — making Unsloth the first local-LLM fine-tuning stack to ship the workflow-state mitigation ahead of the framework cohort's coordinated mid-June default-shipment target now extended to cover all three tier surfaces; an INT8 ONNX export path for the AMD MI350 deployment cohort; and a community Mistral Magistral 22B Mixture-of-Experts recipe at 6 percent peak combined VRAM on dual-RTX 6000 Ada. A fourth Hacker News reproduction lands documenting the Apple Mac Pro 2026 M5 Ultra completing the Qwen3.7-32B router-only recipe through the workflow-state mitigation at 11 percent peak combined VRAM.

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) SGLang RadixArk v0.5.7 + Hugging Face TGI v3.2.0 ship signed-checkpoint loader as default — second and third open-source serving stacks; SGLang first to default it
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday vLLM v0.11.3 shipped a Tuesday point release adding a Sigstore-or-cosign-compatible signature-verified model-checkpoint loader, making vLLM the first open-source serving stack to ship the signed-model-checkpoint primitive at the serving tier; Yotta Labs placed the shared-prefix workload at 16,580 tok/s on vLLM v0.11.3 vs 18,140 tok/s on SGLang RadixArk v0.5.6 (gap narrowed to 9.4 percent from 11.3 percent Monday); Cloudflare Infire L40S edge-tier advantage closed to 1.18x. Today SGLang RadixArk v0.5.7 ships a Wednesday point release adding the same Sigstore-or-cosign-compatible signature-verified loader AND ships it as the documented default load path for new installs (with an explicit unsigned-load opt-out flag for sandboxed test fixtures), making SGLang the second open-source serving stack to ship the primitive AND the first to default it. Hugging Face TGI v3.2.0 ships a parallel Wednesday point release adding the same loader and shipping it as the documented default load path simultaneously with SGLang, making TGI the third open-source serving stack to ship the primitive. Yotta Labs places vLLM v0.11.3 at approximately 17,140 tok/s (up 3 percent from Tuesday) versus 18,860 tok/s on SGLang RadixArk v0.5.7 (up 4 percent from Tuesday) — the throughput gap holds at 9.1 percent essentially flat from Tuesday's 9.4 percent. Cloudflare Infire L40S edge-tier advantage closes to 1.12x (vs 1.18x Tuesday) with parity projected at vLLM v0.11.4 on Monday May 18.

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Cerebras CS-4 cohort sample timeline pulls forward Wednesday — OpenAI first batch mid-Q1 2027 (from late-Q1 2027); Nvidia Vera Rubin second-batch samples accelerate one quarter

items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Optimus Gen 3 reaches 48 units active on Fremont with first three-shift coordination demonstration; Volkswagen Wolfsburg signals parallel Optimus pilot for fiscal H2 2026
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday a third cohort of 12 Optimus Gen 3 units activated at Fremont bringing total active to 36 of the 240-unit allocation, cycle-time tightened to a 1.10x human-baseline envelope, Tesla Robotics posted a 180-second clip showing twelve units performing a coordinated four-station hand-off chain across day-shift and swing-shift cohorts — the first multi-shift coordination demonstration in production — and Stellantis confirmed the Detroit 60-unit pilot pulls forward to June 8. items.headline: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Verifiable Workflow-State Path Canonicalization preprint covers nine-CVE pattern; runtime-verifier paper v2 extends mid-June framework target to workflow-state tier
items.diff_narrative: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Yesterday two fresh research story-threads landed: Verifiable Cross-Hemispheric Composition (arxiv 2605.06584) extended the Monday End-to-End Sovereign-Cloud paper with formal verification of jurisdiction-boundary-crossing capability gating across the eleven-jurisdiction cohort, Cross-Vendor Agentic-AI Evaluation Harness (arxiv 2605.06641) shipped a Tuesday evaluation harness covering the eight-CVE agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader pattern, and DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft co-published Runtime Signature-Verification and Manifest-Allowlist Enforcement for Agentic AI Inference Pipelines (arxiv 2605.06712) extending the Monday Signed-Checkpoint preprint to the inference-routing tier. Today opens a fresh research story-thread: Verifiable Workflow-State Path Canonicalization for Agentic AI Multi-Tier Loaders (arxiv 2605.06799) ships Wednesday as a fresh paper extending the runtime-verifier preprint plus the Tuesday inference-routing addendum to cover the workflow-state path tier exposed by the Wednesday AutoGen CVE-2026-44918 disclosure; the paper provides formal compositional safety theorems for the three-tier load-runtime-workflow loader pattern plus reference implementations in Python and Rust, with Stanford CIS plus the Brennan Center adding as institutional reviewers. Runtime Signature-Verification v2 (arxiv 2605.06712v2) extends the Tuesday runtime-verifier paper with a workflow-state path-canonicalization integration pattern; Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, and AutoGen maintainer teams publish parallel Wednesday commitments to ship the three-tier mitigation integration as default in the next minor-version release.
